notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK check for timestamped interaction service-report failures. The source uses only the official IEEE 1516.1 C++ RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs, standard MIM data elements, standard logical-time interfaces, and the standard library; the adapter supplies the provider package, ordinary FOM, standard MIM, logical-time implementation, endpoint, and callback configuration. It verifies typed failure reports, optional timestamp arguments, exception identity, returned-argument encoding, serial progression, and application-callback suppression without provider-specific headers, registries, names, or diagnostics.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador timestamped SendInteraction failure boundaries and FederateAmbassador service-report delivery
api_surfaces.source_symbol: IEEE 1516.1 RTIambassador, FederateAmbassador, and logical-time service-report declarations
